authorization: User requested execution of all ten proposed experiments, including a separately scoped second-family replication after a stable effect.

resources.replication_rule: Reserve the replication allowance from the global primary ledger before using a separate checkpoint-specific child ledger; reconcile actual elapsed time after the serialized job.
resources.downloads: Only small public metadata/reference source; all model weights must already be cached.

diagnostic_selection.structural_scope: Numeric calibration validation shares task structures; no confirmatory generalization claim.

experiments.name: Binding and version competition
experiments.gate: At least one diagnostic protocol passes its fresh validation. Prefer the computed task; otherwise explicitly scope the study to literal/copy bindings. Use matched value multisets, ownership swaps and version substitutions with predefined oracle answers.

experiments.name: Naming by competition by updates
experiments.gate: Use the validated task and frozen protocol. Run the complete balanced naming/load/update design with tokenizer-length audits; no selection of favorable cells.

experiments.name: Tracking versus query-time reconstruction
experiments.gate: Use fresh captures under the selected protocol, fixed pre-query/post-query sites and labels visible at each prefix. Earlier causal token representations cannot depend on a later query.

experiments.name: Distributed-state probe diagnostics
experiments.gate: Match decoder capacity, train-only preprocessing, surface information and randomized-label controls. Select all readout choices on development, with no final-test activations.

experiments.name: Value, ownership and pathway interventions
experiments.gate: First demonstrate reproducible counterfactual value transfer on a usable baseline. Advance to ownership and path tests only after the preceding assay succeeds; include wrong-owner/version, same-answer, unrelated-donor, norm and reciprocal controls.

experiments.name: Frozen failure prediction
experiments.gate: Require an evidence-supported explanation, genuine scientific registration, explicit query/feature contracts and frozen predictions before opening final outcomes. Compare A/B/C and the cheap stress baseline with clustered uncertainty.

experiments.name: Second-family replication
experiments.gate: Replicate an observed stable, selective effect on the pinned cached CodeGemma checkpoint. No mechanism-free replication result is invented when experiment 8 has no eligible effect.

heldout_rule: All previous and fresh confirmatory model outcomes remain sealed until experiment 9 has a genuine frozen analysis and forecast artifact.
stopping_rule: Respect every prerequisite. Record failed or unavailable prerequisites as not run, never as completed experiments. Preserve the earlier pilot and its separate stopping decision.
